messages:
maria: CI deploy failing on prod CI job 7845, failing impersonation with 403. Started right after we tightened SA bindings yesterday. Anyone seen this?
kevin: Can you paste the exact error payload or the log snippet?
maria: here's the response from the API call the runner makes:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  "error": {"code": 403, "message": "Request had insufficient authentication scopes.", "status": "PERMISSION_DENIED", "details": [{"@type": "type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.DebugInfo", "detail": "required permission: iam.serviceAccounts.get or iam.serviceAccounts.signBlob or iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken"}]
}
```
maria: Repro steps: gitlab runner uses workload identity to mint token, then calls our internal impersonation proxy which calls `projects.serviceAccounts.generateAccessToken`. Command from runner: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://inference-api.company/impersonate?sa=ci-deployer@redwood-prod`
asha: This is classic missing iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on the *source* principal or missing get on the *target* SA. We recently removed broad org-level bindings; likely the runner principal lost the tokenCreator role on the ci-deployer SA.
kevin: Checking audit logs now — log id: log-0x9a7f3b. I see an entry: "permission denied for iam.serviceAccounts.generateAccessToken on serviceAccount:ci-deployer@redwood-prod". That lines up.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: pipeline 7845 failed — job aborted (see logs).
sre-oncall: Workaround: grant `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` to `serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-inference-prod` for that specific target SA, then rotate and retry. Short-lived fix, but we should scope it tightly.
maria: Can we do a scoped binding just for the impersonation window? We need a rollback plan if that escalates.
kevin: I'll add a binding scoped to the single service account (not project-wide). Running:
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding ci-deployer@redwood-prod \
  --member=serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-inference-prod \
  --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
```
Doing it now.
(10s later) kevin: Bound. Retrying pipeline.
maria: Confirmed — job 7845 succeeded after the binding.
asha: Follow-up actions: 1) Add a CI checklist to runbook to validate impersonation bindings after org-policy changes; 2) Add an automated check in infra CI that attempts a dry-run impersonation on critical pipelines; 3) Document least-privilege pattern: grant tokenCreator only on the exact target SA, not at project level.
sre-oncall: I'll file a short incident note and add a tag to the deployment playbook.
maria: Thanks both. Leaving this thread open until runbook PR lands.
